risks.description: The word timings are unknown because these meetings were recorded before the segmentation existed, so an overlap cannot be confirmed as real
Any script approximating the alignment would suffer from slippage

open_questions.description: Which approach to take -- using non-lapel channels if the alignments are good enough, or aligning Thilo's energy segmentations with what they have
How to tell a real overlap from a segment merely correlated with an overlap, without knowing where the words fall in time

notes: No decisions and no actions: the case is entirely option-weighing for a Eurospeech paper, and nothing is chosen or taken on. fe008's 'in principle I could imagine writing a script' (seg-0049) is explicitly hypothetical and is not an action -- it is the kind of phrasing an extractor most reliably mistakes for a commitment. me011's 'I forgot the digital camera again' (seg-0036) is meeting-room chatter and is correctly nothing.
